prompt.text: Review an already-correct long-form landing (anchor per viewport, rhythm held, tokens clean). Identity-preserving: a correct render is NOT obliged to change — record kept/changed per region with a reason into landing-review.md; zero changes with reasons is a valid outcome.

Stress the landing at viewport 1440x900 with the SAME content fixture both arms use: nine sections, one section with triple-length copy, one with a missing image, and the page read with scroll effects DISABLED. Write scroll-stress.md naming the faults on the actual render — a fault names a region and what is wrong, never only a token/style name.

Judge each viewport-height segment of the landing for ONE anchor (what competes for first attention) on the actual render — the composition question no token check answers. Write anchor-review.md; a mechanical token PASS does not close this review.

Review the long-form landing WITHOUT any screenshot or render available: every claim that needs the render is marked NOT_RUN (what it would take), and no screenshot path is cited as existing. Write render-review.md.

Check the landing under prefers-reduced-motion at the same viewport and content: every scroll narrative degrades to a readable still page and no content is gated on an animation; parity faults name the region and both behaviours. Write motion-parity.md.
